001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.Property;
006
007/**
008 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder }.
009 * Creates a Logback JSON encoder.
010 * <table class="table">
011 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
012 * <tr>
013 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
014 * <th>Type</th>
015 * <th>Required</th>
016 * <th>Default</th>
017 * <th>Description</th>
018 * </tr>
019 * <tr>
020 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_prettyPrint }</code></td>
021 * <td><code>Boolean</code></td>
022 * <td><code>false</code></td>
023 * <td><code>null</code></td>
024 * <td><code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.</td>
025 * </tr>
026 * </table>
027 */
028public final class LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder> {
029
030        /**
031         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
032         * this prefix.
033         */
034        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.encoder.{name}.";
035        
036        /**
037         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prettyPrint } = java.lang.Boolean</code> <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
038         */
039        static final String PROPERTY_prettyPrint = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "prettyPrint";
040        
041        private final String propertyPrefix;
042        final Property<java.lang.Boolean> property_prettyPrint;
043        
044        private final java.lang.String name;
045        private java.lang.@org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Nullable Boolean prettyPrint = null;
046        
047        /**
048         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder }.
049         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.encoder.{name}.</code>. Property name prefix.
050         */
051        public LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder(
052                        java.lang.String name
053                        ) {
054                java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
055                                "name", name
056                        );
057                this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
058                this.name = name;
059                property_prettyPrint = Property.builder()
060                        .ofBoolean()
061                        .build(LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_prettyPrint, prefixParameters));
062
063        }
064
065
066        
067        /**
068         * Sets prettyPrint.
069         * <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
070         * Default is <code>null</code>.
071         * @param prettyPrint <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prettyPrint } = java.lang.Boolean</code> <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
072         * @return this builder.
073         */
074        public LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder prettyPrint(java.lang.@org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Nullable Boolean prettyPrint) {
075                this.prettyPrint = prettyPrint;
076                return this;
077        }
078        
079        /**
080         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder } from this builder.
081         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder }.
082         */
083        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder build() {
084                return io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder.of(
085                                this.name
086                                , this.prettyPrint
087                                );
088        }
089        
090        @Override
091        public LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
092                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
093                var _prettyPrint = property_prettyPrint.get(properties).or(this.prettyPrint);
094                __v.addIfError(_prettyPrint);
095                __v.validate();
096                this.prettyPrint = _prettyPrint.valueOrNull();
097                return this;
098        }
099        
100        /**
101         * Turns the builder into java.util.Properties like Map skipping values that are null.
102         * @param consumer apply is called where first arg is key and second is value.
103         */
104        public void toProperties(java.util.function.BiConsumer<String, String> consumer) {
105                var _prettyPrint = this.prettyPrint;
106                if (_prettyPrint != null) {
107                        consumer.accept(property_prettyPrint.key(), property_prettyPrint.propertyString(_prettyPrint));
108                }
109        }
110        
111        /**
112         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
113         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
114         */
115        @Override
116        public String propertyPrefix() {
117                return this.propertyPrefix;
118        }
119        
120}
